claim: Try a four-file sample backup check in one click.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert the isolated receipt has 2 accounted, 1 missing, 1 changed, and 50% coverage.

claim: An interrupted check resumes from local inventory state, and Start another check clears it.
sandbox: Fresh 390px browser context; inventory two folders, reload, assert restored state, clear it, and assert both the UI and IndexedDB are empty.

claim: Selected files stay on the device and the core check loads no third-party scripts or services.
where: Landing facts, workspace, privacy policy, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; record every request and assert all are same-origin.

claim: Export a JSON receipt and CSV discrepancy list.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; download both exports and assert the receipt schema/counts and CSV discrepancy rows.

claim: The four demo source records contain complete SHA-256 evidence.
where: How it works, demo documentation, README
sandbox: Fresh /demo; export the source manifest and independently reproduce each 64-character digest from its deterministic fixture stream.

claim: Files through 32 MiB use full SHA-256; larger files use disclosed sampled SHA-256.
where: How it works, workspace guidance, README
sandbox: Hash an exact 32 MiB File and a 32 MiB + 1 byte File; assert method labels and complete 64-character digests.

claim: The receipt reports accounted, missing, changed, extra, and category results and accepts an exported manifest.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; assert every comparison count/category, import its exported source manifest, and observe 100% coverage.

claim: Add several phone and backup folder pairs to one combined receipt.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; add one pair, reload it from local state, add a second pair, then assert per-pair rows and combined exported totals.

claim: The Android app uses persistent read-only selected-tree SAF access and requests no broad storage permission.
where: Android install section, privacy policy, README
sandbox: Inspect the shipped native bridge and manifest for ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE, persisted read access, DocumentFile, and absence of write or broad storage permission.

claim: The Android package excludes private inventory and license state from cloud backup and device transfer.
sandbox: Inspect the Android manifest and both backup-rule formats for disabled backup and complete database/shared-preference exclusions.

claim: New Android releases use one protected signing identity, higher version codes, and immutable release tags.
sandbox: Inspect the release workflow and Gradle configuration for encrypted signing secrets, run-number version codes, and unique release tags; reject key generation or asset overwrites.

claim: Local inventories store paths, sizes, dates, and fingerprints, not file contents or EXIF fields.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; inspect isolated IndexedDB records and assert their exact evidence fields and empty localStorage.

claim: The optional $7 one-time Migration Kit keeps at most 20 receipt summaries locally, stores its daily verdict locally, and has no subscription.
sandbox: Fresh /demo with a recorded valid Sociobot response; create 21 receipts, assert 20 local records, price/copy, and only the documented verification request.

claim: A rejected or revoked license locks receipt history without blocking the free verifier or exports.
sandbox: Fresh /demo with a recorded revoked response; assert the token leaves the URL, history stays locked, and the receipt/export remain available.
Fresh /demo; invoke Print receipt, assert the browser print action, and verify the receipt remains present in print media.

claim: The product works at 390 px and with keyboard controls.
sandbox: Fresh 390x844 page; assert no overflow, facts inside the viewport, 44 px links, skip-link focus, and keyboard activation of the folder control.

claim: The installable sample receipt reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh /?demo=1; verify standalone manifest icons, install the worker, go offline, reload, and assert the sample receipt remains visible.

claim: Folder checks and both receipt downloads work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Service-worker-controlled /?demo=1; go offline, issue the receipt, then download and assert both JSON and CSV files.
